changes: Service-only inbox projection authorizes homeowner, assigned contractor or designated payer; no broader direct jobs access or property secret exposure.
Database pagination orders by activity and job UUID, retaining timestamp precision. Snapshot cut-off keeps new messages from moving unseen conversations out of an ongoing traversal.
Per-job latest-message lookup prevents a busy conversation from starving other previews; unread counts include only messages addressed to the authenticated actor.
Web and mobile consume cursor pages with deduplication and fresh cursor state on refresh. Non-advancing cursors and database failures surface as errors.
rollout: Apply the new inbox function migration before deploying its API consumer.
Deploy API before releasing updated mobile clients; legacy clients retain first-page shape and ISO cursors remain accepted.
Exact deployed cookie/bearer transport and device acceptance remain F12.
